source_currentness: Direct INEGI date and public GAIA endpoints timed out on 2026-10-29. Reused latest advertised editions verified 2026-10-12: municipios June 2026, localidades August 2026. No access-block workaround used.

methods_extra.translations: Own code-verified item label, exact pt independent of pt-br; pt-BR pt-br then pt. Latin fallback official name. Omit unavailable non-Latin labels and any with Latin characters. Chinese priority zh-hans/zh-cn/zh, normalized to Simplified with system ICU uconv Hans.
methods_extra.point: Catalogue fallback is official municipio cabecera localidad representative point, population always municipio LOC=0000. Points never moved on existing rows.
